messages:
anya: morning quick sync — what I did / blockers / today
anya: DID: finished the new SDK quickstart for Python + JS (added auth examples and a tiny streaming snippet). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/pull/212
anya: BLOCKER: need a short blurb from infra about default rate limits for new accounts so we can document expected behavior
kevin: i can add that — default is 60 rpm and 5 concurrent streams for hosted tier unless account is bumped, is that enough wording?
maria: small suggestion: call it 'concurrency' not 'streams' in the docs — users get confused between streams and websockets
anya: good catch, i'll update the copy
sam: FYI I left inline comments on the PR about the code sample using sync vs async clients
anya: thanks, responding to those now. deciding to show async for streaming and sync for single-response to keep examples minimal
jon: DID: ran through the macOS dev onboarding and fixed the Homebrew install step in the sample app README — there was a stray env var name
jon: BLOCKER: CI flakes on running sample-app integration tests on GH Actions (timeout on install-libtorch step)
kevin: try setting APT_MIRROR in actions? we saw latency from ubuntu mirrors earlier this week
jon: will try that and push a CI change, thanks
maria: DID: updated the docs site navigation so quickstarts are under "Get started" and added the SDK version matrix table
maria: TODAY: will add a short note about pinned model versions and how rollouts work in Dedicated (ask: does product have a 1-2 line canonical phrasing?)
anya: product phrase: "Pin a model version to avoid unexpected behavior during rollouts; use canary deployments for gradual traffic shifts." feel free to tweak
sam: quick check: should sample apps use the new redwood-sdk v0.8 import path? i.e. `from redwood import Client` vs `from redwood_sdk import Client`
anya: yes use `redwood` package name in quickstarts — we updated the package name last week
sam: cool, i'll update the node and python samples and run them locally
devrel-bot: reminder — docs snapshot job completed for master at 1769549900, artifacts: https://ci.internal/redwood/docs/snapshots/1769549900
kevin: reaction :thumbsup: to the snapshot
anya: tiny ask: can someone glance at the sample app auth flow? i added kiosk flow and want a second set of eyes on token refresh logic
maria: happy to — i'll do a quick review after lunch
jon: when PRs are ready, @kevin can you tag docs-approve so we can merge and publish?
kevin: will do, ping me in-thread when ready
anya: thanks all — i'll update PR with infra wording, switch samples to package name `redwood`, and address sam's comments. back around 1600 PT for follow-ups
kevin: noted
sam: thanks — i'll push the node update by EOD and link the new sample commit here
anya: closing loop: added the small code snippet showing streaming in the quickstart:
anya: ```python
anya: from redwood import Client
anya: client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
anya: with client.stream("gpt-like-model") as s:
anya:     for chunk in s:
anya:         print(chunk.text, end="")
anya: ```
anya: ok i'm done, will DM infra for the rate limit blurb if kevin doesn't have time
jon: thanks everyone
devrel-bot: note: scheduled docs publish at 1769553600 (will include merged quickstarts)
